app.name: BOTarate
app.description: AI powered extension for teaching and learning assistance

placeholder.teacherMode: Switch to student mode to work on the lab...

welcome.default: You can ask me about the course content. If you want to work on exercises, open a lab first.
welcome.ready: The exercises on this page are ready. Ask me for an explanation or tell me if you want to check your solution for any of them. If you want, I can also give you the list of available exercises.
welcome.identifying: As soon as you identify the exercises, I will be able to help you with them.
welcome.genericHelper: I am here to help you with the course.

status.labBlockedDesc: This lab is blocked because it is a required lab and you have not yet completed the previous lab.

unlockList.complete: Complete the required challenge exercises from the previous lab
unlockList.criteria: Meet the criteria defined by your teacher in the extension options or check the details in "My progress"
unlockList.checkProgress: Check your progress in the "My progress" tab

status.teacherModeDesc: You are in teacher mode. To work on this lab's exercises, you must switch to student mode.
status.teacherModeAction: Go to the "Mode" switch to change your mode.
status.analyzingContent: Analyzing page content to identify available exercises.
status.notConfiguredDesc: The teacher has not configured this lab yet. The chat is disabled until the configuration is available.
status.notConfiguredAction: Please wait for your teacher to configure this lab or contact them for more information.

popup.welcome: Welcome to {{appName}}. Configure the extension to start using it.

tooltips.labBlocked: Not available while lab is blocked

noExercisesMessage.title: No exercises found
noExercisesMessage.desc: This page does not seem to contain exercises

configurationRequired.title: Configuration required

requiredBoth.text: Configuration is required to use the extension:
requiredBoth.assistantConfig: Assistant configuration: Import a configuration file provided by your teacher with the course exercises and labs.
requiredBoth.llmConfig: LLM configuration: Configure the API key and AI provider model from the extension options page.

configurationRequired.requiredExercise: No assistant configuration found. Please import a configuration file provided by your teacher to start using the extension.

requiredLLM.text: LLM is not configured. To use the extension you need to:
requiredLLM.key: Configure the AI provider API key (OpenAI, Google, etc.)

configurationRequired.llmWarning: To configure the LLM, go to the extension options page, set your API key and a compatible model, save the configuration and reload this page.

llm.title: Language Model Configuration
llm.apiKeyError: Invalid API key. Please enter a valid API key to view models.
llm.textModelHelp: Used for chat, explanations, and evaluations

subject.label: Subject
subject.desc: Name of the subject for which assistants are configured

platform.label: LMS Platform
platform.desc: Name of the educational platform (e.g., Moodle, Canvas, Egela)

labMaterial.label: Lab material
labMaterial.desc: Describes what context should be extracted from lab materials

exerciseCriteria.label: Exercise identification
exerciseCriteria.desc: Criteria for identifying what constitutes an exercise and how it should be extracted

role.label: Role
role.desc: Defines the role/purpose of the assistant in the context of the course

feedbackFormat.label: Feedback format
feedbackFormat.desc: Instructions on how to structure and format feedback

studentMode.warning: Student mode: To configure the extension, import the configuration file provided by your teacher.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language affects the interface and assistant responses

exerciseConfig.infoDesc: In this tab you can configure which exercises are challenge or picky.

infoList.challenge: Challenge exercises: Explanations cannot be requested, but solution evaluations can.
infoList.picky: Picky exercises: A warning is shown when asking for an explanation because they may contain partial answers in the statement.

exerciseConfig.infoFooter: After saving changes, the system will automatically update the restrictions.
exerciseConfig.noExercisesDesc: When exercises are detected on the page, you can configure which ones are challenge exercises.
exerciseConfig.unsavedDesc: Click "Save changes" to apply the configuration and regenerate the assistant.

labConfig.noLabsDesc: No 'page' type resources found in the course that can be configured as labs.
labConfig.infoDesc: Configure which labs to include and their required level, verbosity and reasoning options.

infoList.include: Include lab: Enable this to analyze the lab and extract exercises. This is required before other configuration options can be used.
infoList.required: Required lab: Labs marked as required will unlock sequentially when the student completes the challenges of the previous lab.
infoList.verbosity: Verbosity level: Controls the level of detail in the assistant's explanations (low, medium, or high).
infoList.reasoning: Reasoning effort: Configures how much detail the assistant should put into explaining its reasoning (minimal, low, medium, or high).

labConfig.infoFooter: Click on an included lab to expand its configuration options.
labConfig.unsavedDesc: Click "Save changes" to apply the configuration.
labConfig.unsavedContext: Context will be generated for newly included labs.

info.title: Configure criteria to unlock labs
info.desc: Adjust the minimum score and percentage of passed challenges needed to progress.

minScore.label: Minimum score to pass a challenge exercise
minScore.help: Challenges with a score equal to or higher than this value will be considered passed.

minPercentage.label: Minimum percentage of passed challenges to progress
minPercentage.help: Example: with 75%, if a lab has 4 challenges, at least 3 must be passed to unlock the next one.

progress.errorLoad: Could not load configuration. Please try again.
progress.errorSave: Could not save. Check values and try again.

export.title: Export configuration
export.description: Export all your configuration (assistants, exercises, and labs) to a JSON file. You can use this file to make backups or transfer the configuration to another browser.

import.title: Import configuration
import.description: Import a configuration from a previously exported JSON file. This will overwrite existing data with the file's data.
import.warningDesc: Importing will overwrite existing data. It is recommended to export first as a backup.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently delete all data stored by the extension. This action cannot be undone.

messages.clearSuccess: All data has been deleted successfully

importExport.confirmClear:
⚠️ WARNING: This action will delete ALL saved configuration, including:

- Assistant configuration
- Identified exercise data
- Configured lab data

This action CANNOT be undone. Are you sure you want to continue?

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.noExercisesDesc: When exercises are detected on the page, they will appear here along with any saved explanations and evaluations.

pickyWarning.title: Exercise marked as picky.
pickyWarning.desc: This explanation might not be completely correct. Review the steps carefully and consult your teacher if you find anything strange.

retry.title: Do you want to try again?
retry.desc: You can close this modal and request to solve the exercise again to submit a new solution.

list.title: Evaluations for {{name}}
list.emptyDesc: You have not submitted any solutions for evaluation for this exercise yet.
list.selectPrompt: Select an evaluation from the history to view details.

chat.title: Questions about the explanation
chat.subtitle: Ask questions about any step of the explanation
chat.empty: Do you have any questions about the explanation? Ask me anything.

progress.title: Progress
progress.noLabsDesc: The teacher has not yet configured the lab and progression system for this course.
progress.infoDesc: Labs unlock sequentially. To access a lab, you must complete the challenge exercises of the previous lab following the criteria defined by your teacher.

infoList.challenge: Challenge exercises: Cannot be explained by AI, but can be evaluated when you submit your solution.
infoList.score: Recorded score: Your best score for each exercise is saved.
infoList.required: Required labs only: This view shows only the labs marked as required by the teacher, which must be completed in order to advance.

progress.minPercentage: Minimum percentage of passed challenges: {{percentage}}% of the total challenges in the lab

labCard.title: Lab {{index}}: {{name}}
labCard.noChallenges: There are no challenge exercises in this lab.
labCard.locked: Lab locked. Complete the previous lab following the configured criteria.

errors.exerciseBlocked: The exercise "{{exerciseName}}" is blocked and cannot be explained.

progressSummary.noProgress: The student has not completed any labs or exercises yet.
